Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q6_2

datasets_used: HIFLD Next power-plants-1 (Power Plants, geoparquet/geojson, v1.0.0)
FEMA NFHL Harris County extract 48201C, S_FLD_HAZ_AR.shp (filtered to SFHA_TF = 'T')
workspace files: power_plants.geojson, plants_harris_op100.geojson, sfha_harris.gpkg, sfha_utm.gpkg, sfha_buf500.gpkg, plants_utm.gpkg, plants_near_sfha.gpkg
output.method: I took the HIFLD Power Plants layer and kept Harris County (COUNTYFIPS 48201) plants with STATUS 'OP' and OPER_CAP >= 100 MW, which gave 18 plants. I took FEMA's NFHL Harris County S_FLD_HAZ_AR polygons with SFHA_TF = 'T' as the Special Flood Hazard Area, reprojected both layers to EPSG:26915 (metres), dissolved a 500 m buffer around the SFHA, and kept plants that intersect that buffer; 5 plants qualify. The SFHA definition used is the SFHA_TF flag, and I did not run a separate nearest-distance check on the other 13 plants."}
